name: Left-priority turn at a single front obstacle
expected: Tick 3: obstacle (4,1) ahead: front interrupt F = true. Left (3,2) and right (5,2) are both free, so the RVC turns LEFT (C4): Disable Move Forward, Clean = clean_off, Direction = Turn Left.
Ticks 4-5: still turning, no outputs; F stays true and is not acted on (C15). Heading W at end of tick 5.
Tick 6: front interrupt F = false; Direction = Forward, Clean = clean_on. The RVC moves W along row 2.
Tick 10: wall ahead at (0,2), left (S) free: another left turn.
function_text: EF-03 – Front obstacle detection by interrupt (walls and obstacles); false only updates the store
EF-06 – Avoidance: turn left, left has priority when both sides are free
EF-08 – 3-tick turn, then resume forward with clean_on
EF-09 – Cleaning stopped (clean_off) only while turning or reversing
EF-16 – Front interrupt during a turn or reverse is not acted on
